Messages.Author: Ulugh Beg II
Messages.Body:
Hi.
 
Yet another question from me.
 
With Ian in the !Tremere starter, I'm sure we're gonna see him on the table a whole lot more now. Of course I'm not aware of the new card text, but the old one says that if he has a master discipline card on him, he gets the superior variant at once.
 
How about Sanguine Instruction? It isn't really a Master Discipline card, but it *does* teach him a "level" of a Discipline. Does he also get the superior right away from this card?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. SI only gives him one level of the discipline.
Since he starts at level 0, adding a level puts him at level 1, not 2.
